title: Namespaces this project mints
description: Every namespace IRI folio-assistant mints for itself, with what each one names. Code reads the values from here (schemas/kg/namespaces.ts); external-schemas:check fails on a spelling of ours that is not listed, and on a retired one still in use.

source.note: owner, 2026-09-23: code lists as nodes rather than constants in code

codes.label: bootstrap vocabulary
codes.definition: JSON-LD terms the bootstrap layer declares; the prefix is the layer stub.

source.note: schemas/kg/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: cat-harness vocabulary
codes.definition: JSON-LD terms the cat-harness layer declares; the prefix is the layer stub.

source.note: schemas/kg/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: legacy single vocabulary
codes.definition: The single namespace every term used before the per-layer split. Kept so the vocabulary document can name the stem it published under; never minted into.

source.note: schemas/kg/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: content @base
codes.definition: The @base every emitted content document resolves relative ids against. An IRI this project mints, but a base rather than a vocabulary: no term hangs off it.

source.note: schemas/kg/jsonld.ts FOLIO_BASE, where it was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: published site root
codes.definition: The root the docs site is served at: _config.yml url + baseurl. A PUBLISHED asset's IRI is minted under it, so the IRI dereferences to the file — a library entry at <root>assets/library/jsonld/<instance>/source/<id>, its JSON-LD at that IRI plus .jsonld. A base, not a vocabulary.

source.note: owner, 2026-10-02: "each asset should have one IRI, but the view page is a rendering of that asset, a different page. fix IRIs"

codes.label: retired single BPMN extension address
codes.definition: The one XML namespace every BPMN extension element was in until 2026-09-24. Retired then (bean 12s9): each element is now in the namespace of the Subgraph that declares it, bootstrap-processes or cat-harness-processes. Listed so a check can name it when a diagram still binds it.

source.note: bean 0d99, 2026-09-20; retired by bean 12s9, 2026-09-24, once no diagram in the owner's repositories bound it (the last, ihris, moved in litlfred/ihris#24)

codes.label: bootstrap's BPMN extension elements
codes.definition: The XML namespace of the BPMN extension elements bootstrap declares for its own diagrams: skill, role and precondition. Its prefix names the declaring Subgraph, bootstrap.processes.

source.note: bean 12s9 stage 2, owner 2026-09-24: prefix = declaring Subgraph (dotted path), address option 1 (…/ns#)

codes.label: cat-harness's BPMN extension elements
codes.definition: The XML namespace of the BPMN extension elements cat-harness declares for diagrams: bean, policy, adjudication, no-skill, no-call, job, implements, judgement, fulfilment, raci, involvement, link, decision, log and convention. Its prefix names the declaring Subgraph, cat-harness.processes.

source.note: bean 12s9 stage 3, owner 2026-09-24: prefix = declaring Subgraph, address <stub>/<subgraph>/ns#

codes.label: never-ours BPMN spelling
codes.definition: A spelling of the extension namespace on a domain this project does not own. Listed only so a check can name it when it reappears.

codes.label: process diagrams
codes.definition: The targetNamespace every process diagram declares, so every calledElement names a process in the caller's own namespace.

codes.label: IG AST vocabulary
codes.definition: The vocabulary the IG AST's JSON-LD export uses for what FHIR does not name (key, file, dependsOn, target, provisional ...), and the base of the generated IG AST JSON Schemas' $id. An identifier, following the <stub>/<instance>/<version>/ns/<vocab># pattern; not a resolvable address.
